title: Chemistry
credential: Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Chemistry

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Chemistry series

Applicants must complete the General Chemistry sequence with a minimum grade of 2.0 in each course

• B CHEM 143/144 General Chemistry I w/ Lab

• B CHEM 153/154 General Chemistry II w/ Lab

• B CHEM 163/164 General Chemistry III w/ Lab

Mathematics series

Applicants must complete the Calculus sequence with a minimum grade of 2.0 in each course

• STMATH 124 Calculus I

• STMATH 125 Calculus II

• STMATH 126 Calculus III
sourceText.degree-completion:
Completion Requirements

Physics series (TOTAL of 15 credits)

• B PHYS 121 Mechanics (5 credits)

• B PHYS 122 Electromagnetism and Oscillatory Motion (5 credits)

• B PHYS 123 Waves (5 credits)

OR

• B PHYS 114 General Physics and B PHYS 117 General Physics Laboratory (4 + 1 credits)

• B PHYS 115 General Physics and B PHYS 118 General Physics Laboratory (4 + 1 credits)

• B PHYS 116 General Physics and B PHYS 119 General Physics Laboratory (4 + 1 credits)

Mathematics series (TOTAL of 5 credits)

Choose any one from the following mathematics courses

• STMATH 207 Introduction to Differential Equations

• STMATH 208 Matrix Algebra with applications

• STMATH 224 Multivariable Calculus

• STMATH 341 Introduction to Statistical Inferences

Chemistry series (TOTAL of 48 - 50 credits that includes upper division and elective chemistry courses)

• B CHEM 237 Organic Chemistry I (4 credits)

• B CHEM 238 Organic Chemistry II (4 credits) + B CHEM 241 Organic Chemistry Laboratory I (3 credits)

• B CHEM 239 Organic Chemistry III (4 credits) + B CHEM 242 Organic Chemistry Laboratory II (3 credits)

• B CHEM 294 Chemistry Seminar (1 credit)

• B CHEM 312 Inorganic Chemistry I

• B CHEM 316 Quantitative Chemical Analysis and Equilibrium Chemistry

• B CHEM 317 Quantitative Environmental Analysis Lab

• B CHEM 401 Physical Chemistry I

• B CHEM 402 Physical Chemistry II

• B CHEM 495 Investigative Chemistry I

• B CHEM 497 Apprenticeship in Chemistry Education (3 credits maximum)

Upper Division Chemistry Electives: Complete seven (7) credits from any of the following courses including at least one lab.

• B CHEM 310 Molecular Modeling

• B CHEM 313 Inorganic Chemistry II

• B CHEM 350 Atmospheric Chemistry and Air Pollution

• B BIO 364/B CHEM 364 Biochemistry I

• B BIO 365/B CHEM 365 Biochemistry II

• B BIO 366/B CHEM 366 Biochemistry Lab

• B BIO 375/B CHEM 375 Molecular Biology

• B CHEM 404 Physical Chemistry Lab

• B CHEM 426 Instrumental Analysis

• B CHEM 493 Advanced Topics in Chemistry (5 credits maximum)

• B CHEM 494 Special Topics in Biochemistry (3 credits maximum)

• B CHEM 498 Approved Independent Study in Chemistry (5 credits maximum)

• B CHEM 499 Approved Undergraduate Research in Chemistry (5 credits maximum)

TOTAL for Physics, Mathematics, and all Chemistry courses = 68 - 70 credits

Additional Courses: As needed to fulfill the University General Education Requirements

Grade Requirements: Minimum 2.0 grade in each course used to satisfy the major
